introduction.text: Casa dell'Architettura is a contemporary architectural space located in Rome, housed in the historic Acquario Romano building, a notable example of late 19th‑century civic architecture.

history.description: Designed by Ettore Bernich, the Acquario Romano was built between 1885 and 1887 as an aquarium.
After a period of abandonment, the building was restored and now serves as the Casa dell'Architettura, hosting exhibitions and performances.

design.description: The building features a circular plan with a pronaos and aediculae, marine-themed decorations, caryatids, medallions, and a cylindrical body subdivided by lesenes and pilasters.

art.description: Marine subject decorations are inserted between the sculptures in the aediculae, creating a thematic artistic narrative.
